mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 12-month year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.5% triggers central bank tightening expectations, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment decline (UNRATE) signal strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate consumption effects.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500 thousand units and real personal consumption (RSAFS) exceed 650 billion dollars, consumer spending acceleration drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through earnings momentum.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates tightening labor market conditions that support higher consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is declining.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal monetary tightening with persistent inflation, reducing real disposable income and corporate margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances (Rank IC > -0.03).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and GDP (GDPC1) level is below 19500 billion, manufacturing slowdown and weak economic output signal recessionary pressures that depress S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition.
